send.description: Send a message as the bot to this channel or another

copyPaste.description: Copy a message to a channel

editCopy.description: Edit a bot message with the content of another message

editSend.description: Edit a message sent by this bot

react.description: React to a message, optionally adding numbered poll choices

destinationOption.description: Channel to send to; defaults to this channel

replyMessageOption.description: Link of the message to reply to; used instead of the destination

copySourceOption.description: Link of the message to copy

newMessageLinkOption.description: Link of the message to take the new content from

oldBotMessageLinkOption.description: Link of the bot message to edit

newContentOption.description: New text; leave empty to edit it in a dialog

reactTargetOption.description: Link of the message to react to

emojiOption.description: Emoji to react with; the message's own reactions are suggested

reactChoiceCountOption.description: Number of numbered poll choices to add (0-10)

pollChoiceCountOption.description: Number of poll choices to add (1-10)

pollMessageLinkOption.description: Message to add the choices to; leave empty to post a new one

emptyContent: The message must not be empty!
notBotMessage: The old message was not sent by this bot!

nothingToCopy.source: The source message has no text or attachment to copy!
nothingToCopy.new: The new message has no text or attachment to copy!

problem.TOO_LONG: The source message is longer than 2000 characters, which the bot cannot send.
problem.FILES_TOO_LARGE: The files of the source message are larger than the destination server accepts.
